issues.description: transition.ex's own moduledoc (lines 38-42) presents a grep command and claims it 'must return zero matches' against lib/letflow/engine/*.ex, but running that exact command returns 4 matches -- all self-referential (the moduledoc's own prose quotes 'Logger.*', 'DateTime.utc_now/0', 'System.os_time/1', 'System.system_time/1', 'File.*/HTTPoison/Req.*' and the grep command text itself). Does not indicate an actual purity violation (all 4 matches fall inside the @moduledoc block, none in executable code), but the documented verification command is not literally reproducible as worded -- a future automated gate that runs it verbatim and expects exit-clean/zero-match would false-positive. Consider scoping the grep to exclude the moduledoc block, or wording AC1's verification note to acknowledge the self-reference.
